the board.max play: 💎 2u - the hockey Dog of the Day when the dog is rested, the favorite played last night and the dog score is 8+ (several things agreeing, never one factor); a label on the Dog, never an extra pick; about 17 a hockey season; off at 25 graded under 44% won (11/16)
